title: feat(types): refuse `label` on the widget-slot `metric-card`, naming `title` (objectui#4425)
body:
Fixes #4425

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## Summary

A `metric-card` placed directly in a dashboard's `widgets[]` now refuses `label` by name, and the refusal names `title`. That is the key `MetricCard` draws as the card heading. The card inherited `label` from `BaseSchema` without reading it. So a card authored with `label`, which is the sibling `metric` node's spelling, validated on every face and drew a card with no heading.

This is the card's second half. The DOM half landed as objectui#11668 (`a600924`). This half executes triage's answer `6008987293`: option A, settled by the standing objectui#8284 ruling (`5572150897`: one spelling per rendered thing, the other refused by name, `?: never` on the TypeScript face). After this PR the card has nothing open. No `LEAK_LEDGER` row names it: `issue: 'objectui#4425'` has 0 hits in `widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`, and the same pattern finds the 4 `objectui#5574` rows, so the instrument is not blind. The plugin-widget contract is stated in `content/docs/guide/plugin-development.md` ("What Reaches the DOM"), and the label half is this PR. So the body uses `Fixes`.

## What changed

- **zod, `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts`.** The private widget-slot component arm (`DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema`, the first arm of the slot's union) gains a `label` member built by `aliasKeyRefusal('label', 'title', …)`, with the site detail in a new constant, `METRIC_CARD_LABEL_IS_TITLE`. The arm keeps `label` as a member whose `z.never` refuses at the key's own path with code `invalid_type`. The message leads with ``Unrecognized key(s) on this `metric-card` node: `label`. Did you mean `label` → `title`?`` and goes on to say why. One string feeds both the issue message and `.describe()`. The detail constant is module-private, like `METRIC_CARD_NEITHER_CHANNEL` beside it. The derived strict face inherits the member.
- **TypeScript, `packages/types/src/complex.ts`.** `DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema` restates the inherited member as `label?: never`, with a docblock naming `title`. This is the same shape the arm's `body` / `children` pair took for objectui#9256.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/4425-metric-card-label-refused.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/types`, with the BREAKING banner. objectui never declares `major` (AGENTS.md section 9).

## Measured at the public doors, before (`c3623eb`) and after (`05c8d31`)

Fixtures are one-widget dashboards. `objectui validate` was run as the built CLI (`node packages/cli/dist/cli.js validate FILE`). The strict face is `StrictAnyComponentSchema` read from the built `dist`. The TypeScript face is the built `dist/index.d.ts`, compiled by a scratch program that is not committed. After the change, the types package was rebuilt before each reading.

| face | card | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `objectui validate` | `value` + `label` | exit 0, `Schema is valid!` | exit 1. `1.1 Unrecognized key(s) on this metric-card node: label. Did you mean label → title? …`, at `widgets → 0 → label`, code `invalid_type` |
| `objectui validate` | `value` + `title` + `label` | exit 0 | exit 1, same refusal |
| `objectui validate` | `value` + `title` (control) | exit 0 | exit 0 |
| `objectui validate` | no `value` (instrument control) | exit 1 | exit 1 |
| `objectui validate` | `label` inside a widget's legacy `component` envelope | exit 0 | exit 0. The measured limit, see Acceptance notes |
| strict face | `value` + `label` | ACCEPT | REFUSE, `invalid_type` at `widgets.0.label`, same message |
| strict face | `label` inside the `component` envelope | ACCEPT | REFUSE, `invalid_type` at `widgets.0.component.label` |
| strict face | `value` + `title` | ACCEPT | ACCEPT |
| `tsc` on the built declarations | `label` on the interface, in `widgets[]`, in the envelope | compiles | 3 × TS2322 (`Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`) |
| `tsc` on the built declarations | `title` | compiles | compiles |
| `tsc` on the built declarations | `someProp` (negative control) | TS2353 | TS2353 |

**No widening, so `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` holds.** The built declarations were compared with the base build after union-member order was normalised. tsc emitted union members in a different order across the two builds, so a raw diff is noise. Three changes remain. `complex.d.ts` gains the member and its docblock, +20 lines. `zod/complex.zod.d.ts` has 5 × `label` going from the I18nLabel union to `z.ZodOptional of z.ZodNever`. `zod/index.zod.d.ts` has 4 × `label?:` going from the I18nLabel union to `undefined`, in the inferred `validateSchema` / `safeValidateSchema` result types. The `export` lines of all 74 declaration files are identical, and no name is added.

## The producer census (Zone 2 item 4)

Instrument: a depth-1 key scan of every object literal whose `type` is `metric-card` or `plugin-dashboard:metric-card`. It ran over all 7511 tracked json / ts / tsx / js / mjs / md / mdx / yaml files at `c3623eb`. It found 97 nodes in 27 files. 60 carry `title`, which is the positive control. 1 carries `label`: case (c) of `MetricWidget.sduiDomWhitelist-4425.test.tsx`, a render-door fixture on the bare registration node. It pins that `label` is never a DOM attribute. It is not authored metadata, it does not go through either schema face, and it stays green. The 11 schema-catalog metric cards and the 25 doc and README nodes carry no `label`. So no producer needed rewriting. This is a reading of one run at the base, and nothing re-derives it. From this PR on, the faces themselves refuse a new one.

## The wider variant: the four other inherited `BaseSchema` members (triage's list, for its follow-up)

Not refused here, per triage. Each was measured at runtime with a temporary probe, not committed. A widget-slot `metric-card` was drawn with and without the key on three doors: `DashboardRenderer`, `DashboardGridLayout`, and a bare `SchemaRenderer` of `plugin-dashboard:metric-card`. Then the markup was compared. The run was deterministic: the control drawn twice gave identical markup. Positive controls: `title` and `className` change the markup on all three doors.

| key | value probed | markup with vs without, on all three doors |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `name` | `'kpi_probe'` | identical |
| `placeholder` | `'PLACEHOLDER-PROBE'` | identical |
| `style` | `{ color: 'rgb(1, 2, 3)', marginTop: 7 }` | identical. The grid cell's own span style is the host's, not the author's |
| `data` | `{ value: 'DATA-PROBE', title: 'DATA-TITLE' }` | identical |
| `label`, for reference | `'LABEL-PROBE'` | identical. Dropped since objectui#11668, and refused from this PR on |

Identical markup means nothing on the renderer or host path turns the key into anything drawn. It does not exclude a read that draws nothing.

## Tests

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/dashboard-widget-slot-component-arm-7952.test.ts` (the arm's own pin file) gains an `objectui#4425` block. It covers:
  - the `title` control on both faces, with keys kept;
  - the refusal at `widgets.0.label`, naming `title`, on the tolerant face and the strict face, with and without `title` alongside;
  - every value refused, because the refusal is about the key;
  - the member is in the arm's shape, and its `.describe()` IS the message;
  - the TypeScript face, as `@ts-expect-error` lines read by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, plus `Equal` of the member and `undefined`;
  - the envelope: refused by the strict face and `tsc`, accepted by the tolerant face, as a recorded limit.
- The new file `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/metricCardLabelRefusedTitleHeading-4425.test.tsx` holds triage's pin where the card renders. Both faces refuse the card with `label` and name `title`, and accept the same card with `title`. On `DashboardRenderer`, `DashboardGridLayout` and the bare registration, the `title` card draws its heading, and the `label` card draws its figure and no heading. No existing test asserted the slot card's heading: the surface pins in `slotEntryWidgetArmReads-11598.test.tsx` and `widget-type-default-and-unknown-11514.test.tsx` read the figure only.

**Ablations, run with the fix committed** (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode; each leg printed `ok mutation landed` and `ok restored: blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD is empty`; no build was needed, because vitest aliases `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/types/zod` to `src` and the TypeScript leg compiles the test program against `src`):

- **Leg Z** deletes the zod `label` member. 7 tests failed, 24 passed. The five 7952 cases that read the zod refusal failed, and so did both face cases in the plugin-dashboard file. These stayed green: the `title` controls, the six render cases (they do not depend on the refusal), and the TypeScript case (`?: never` is erased under vitest). That is the expected split.
- **Leg T** deletes `label?: never` from the TypeScript twin. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` gave exactly 4 errors, all on this block's lines: TS2322 on the `Equal` line and TS2578 (unused `@ts-expect-error`) on the three authoring lines. Nothing else in the program went red.

## Gates, all at head `05c8d31`

Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`, and every exit code was captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`: exit 0. `dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete (148 emitted files verified)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: exit 0. The script echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-designer type-check`: exit 0. These are the two packages that read slot entries, through `isSlotComponentEntry`, and they resolve `@object-ui/types` through its rebuilt `dist`. Their dependency closure was built once at `3ac08c8`. That commit differs from head only in a string and a comment inside `@object-ui/types`, which was rebuilt at head.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/`: exit 0, `Test Files 359 passed (359)`, `Tests 9536 passed (9536)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/`: exit 0, `Test Files 172 passed (172)`, `Tests 1699 passed | 6 skipped (1705)`.
- The schema-catalog `plugin-dashboard-component-schema` and `plugin-dashboard-gallery-render` tests, the app-shell `widget-dom-leak-sweep`, plugin-designer `DashboardEditor.slotComponentArm-11598` and cli `check-validity-recogniser`: exit 0, `Tests 270 passed (270)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types lint` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard lint`: exit 0, 0 errors. `eslint --format json` over the 4 touched source files: 0 errors, and no warning on a changed line. The lint config has no type-aware linting (`projectService` / `parserOptions` 0 hits in `eslint.config.js`), so this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.
- Lockless, all exit 0:
  - `check:new-line-citations` (0 new);
  - `check:control-bytes`;
  - `check:changeset-claims` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check:component-surface-parity` and `check:handler-key-reads`;
  - `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers` and `check:vi-mock-inherit`;
  - `check:self-import` and `check:phantom-deps`;
  - `check:spec-symbols`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:doc-types` and `check:doc-example-readers`;
  - `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence` and `check-changeset-fixed`;
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the five paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED:
  - `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples`. Reason: the gate's `--build-filter` closure is a build of about 35 packages, all cache misses after a `@object-ui/types` change. No doc is touched, and the census above counts 0 doc or README `metric-card` nodes that carry `label`. CI owns it.
  - `check:readme-exports`. Reason: prerequisite not met, unbuilt `dist` of plugin-view / calendar / gantt / kanban.
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins`. Reason: prerequisite not met, no console build.
  - The repo-wide lint, test and type-check farm. Reason: CI-owned. For the other packages that name the narrowed types, app-shell `DashboardPreview` and core `dashboard-filters`, a read of the source shows neither reads `label` off a slot entry. That is a read-only inference, not a type-check.

## Acceptance notes

- **The legacy `component` envelope keeps a tolerant fallback** (reported to the seat, not changed here). Inside `{ id, component: { type: 'metric-card', … } }` the tolerant face's `component` slot is `z.union([slot arm, BaseSchema])`. A card the arm refuses therefore still parses through `BaseSchema`, and `objectui validate` exits 0 on the envelope fixture above. The strict face and `tsc` refuse it. This is the limit the arm's objectui#11467 block already records for a `trend` outside its enum, and it applies to `body` / `children` too. The slot itself, `widgets[]` directly, has no such fallback, and every face refuses.
- `DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema`'s docblock in `complex.ts` still says "Every other key still reaches this arm through `BaseSchema`'s index signature while it stands". The signature went with objectui#8347: the 7952 file's `someProp` case pins `tsc` refusing an undeclared key. A stale sentence, left alone here, not filed.
- Case (c) of `MetricWidget.sduiDomWhitelist-4425.test.tsx` still calls the `label` question "that card's open question". This PR answers it. The file is outside this claim's surface. A stale comment, not filed.
- **Zone 3 route, one substitution.** The refusal uses `aliasKeyRefusal`, not a `retirementTombstone` string. `tombstone.zod.ts` keeps the tombstone for a key the contract withdraws, and the alias helper for "a sibling SPELLING of a declared member", whose message must carry the canonical spelling. `label` here is the second spelling of `title`. The shape is the same as objectui#9256's: a `z.never` member, `invalid_type` at the key's own path, and `?: never` on the twin. The detail string is still one module-private constant beside `METRIC_CARD_NEITHER_CHANNEL`.
- **The silence clause names the parser tier.** objectui#10981's closure walk (`silence-clause-parser-tier-closure-10981.test.ts`) requires it. It went red on the first commit, and the second commit carries the measurement. With the manifest built the way `gen-manifest` builds it, `dashboard` declares no slots, so `validateTree` never reaches a widget-slot card. It draws nothing for `{ value, label }` or for `{ value, title }`. The control, an undeclared key on the dashboard itself, draws `unknown-prop`.
